title: Swap
zcashUnshieldBeforeSwap: Shielded ZEC cannot be swapped directly. To use it, open Zcash → Privacy → Shield and use Unshield to send funds to your own transparent address, then return here once confirmed.
zcashZeroTransparentBalance: 0 ZEC here means no transparent ZEC is available to swap. Your shielded balance is separate; unshield the amount you want to swap first.
reviewApprovalDesc: Approving the router to spend your tokens. Audit before signing.
reviewSwapTxDesc: Confirm the exact payload that will be sent to your KeepKey.
approvalIrrevocableWarning: Approving here broadcasts an on-chain allowance tx that consumes gas. If you cancel the swap step that follows, this approval cannot be reversed without sending another tx.
highSlippageWarning: Slippage tolerance is high ({{pct}}%). You may receive less than expected.
deviceRejected: Cancelled on device — no transaction was sent
reviewTimeout: Review timed out — no transaction was sent
userRejectedTx: You rejected the transaction. No funds moved.
approvalReverted: Approval reverted on-chain — swap aborted to protect funds
insufficientGas: Not enough gas in the source chain's native asset
nonceError: Network error fetching nonce — retry in a moment
networkErrorSwap: Network error — retry in a moment
quoteShiftedReReview: Quote refreshed and dropped {{pct}}% — please review the new numbers and confirm again
payloadStillBuilding: Transaction payload is still building. Review it before confirming.
payloadRequired: Transaction payload is required before confirming.
quoteRefreshedReviewPayload: Quote refreshed. Review the rebuilt payload before confirming.
buildingPayloadDetail: Building the exact transaction payload for review...

broadcastingDesc: Submitting your transaction to the network...
swapSubmittedDesc: Your swap has been submitted to the network

sendMaxGasNote: Output may be slightly less — gas is deducted from the send amount

filterHeld: Filter by symbol, name or network…

approvalBroadcastingDesc: Submitting the approval to the network…
approvalWaitingDesc: Waiting for the approval to mine before we can sign the swap.
blindSignDeclined: Declined on device — blind signing was not enabled.
blindSignEnableFailed: Failed to enable blind signing on the device.
solanaOpaqueTitle: Your KeepKey can't show this Solana transaction
solanaOpaqueBody: Your KeepKey has no review it can show for this transaction, so it signs it only with blind signing on. The summary below was worked out on this computer; your KeepKey cannot confirm it.
solanaOpaqueEnableFailed: Failed to enable Blind Signing on the device.
tronLegacySigningWarning: Firmware before 7.15 may show a generic Tron prompt. Update firmware for native TRX and TRC-20 ClearSign details, or verify the complete payload above before approving.
dustFeeHigh: Heads up — fees + spread will cost {{pct}}% of this swap (~${{lostUsd}} of ${{inUsd}}). For small amounts the fixed protocol fee dominates. Larger swaps get a better rate.
dustFeeSevere: ⚠️ FEES EAT {{pct}}% OF THIS SWAP — you'd lose ${{lostUsd}} of your ${{inUsd}} input. THORChain has a fixed ~$1.20 outbound fee on BTC; small swaps are uneconomic. Strongly recommend ${{minUsd}}+ for this pair, or pick a different route.
insufficientBalanceDetail: You have {{have}} {{symbol}} but the swap needs {{need}} {{symbol}}. The transferFrom would revert on-chain.
insufficientBalanceFix: Lower the amount to ≤{{have}} or top up the source wallet before swapping.
maxInsufficientForGas: Balance is below the fee reserve (~{{reserve}} {{symbol}}). Top up to swap.
maxReserveCloserWarning: Tighter gas reserve; swap may fail if gas moves before signing.
maxReserveDisclosure: MAX swaps {{amount}} {{symbol}} and keeps ~{{reserve}} {{symbol}} for network fees{{usd}}.
swapCancelled: Swap cancelled — confirm again or change inputs
tronBlindSignWarning: Your KeepKey will display a generic Tron transaction prompt — it cannot decode the THORChain swap. Verify the amounts, vault, and memo above before approving on device.
relayDepositReview: Relay executes the swap after your deposit; destination terms are shown in this app.
symbolSquatterWarning: ⚠ Unverified token using the “{{symbol}}” name — this is NOT the native coin. Verify the contract above.
solanaSchemaUnverified: Clear-signing isn't armed on this device this session, so it couldn't verify the swap details. Load the ClearSign signer in Settings, then try again.
swapMemoTooLong: This route returned a memo that is too long for the source chain. Refresh the quote or choose another route.
deviceBlindSignTitle: Your KeepKey can't show this transaction
deviceBlindSignBody: Your KeepKey has no review it can show for this transaction, so it signs it only with blind signing on. With blind signing on, the device asks you to approve without showing what the transaction does.
solanaOutflowUnknown: Could not determine what this transaction does
solanaOutflowAfter: After this transaction your wallet holds
solanaOutflowDrain: Warning: this leaves your wallet empty. Do not sign unless that is what you intended.
solanaOpaqueReason: Your KeepKey cannot read this transaction because of
solanaOutflowCaveat: Simulated against a Solana node from this computer. Your KeepKey cannot confirm these figures.
deviceBlindSignCaveat: Blind signing stays on until the KeepKey locks or is unplugged, for every app that uses it, not just this swap. While it is on, this app also stops showing this screen before such transactions. The device asks you to confirm and to re-enter your PIN.
balanceUnverified: {{symbol}} balance unavailable — the last refresh could not reach this chain, so MAX is unavailable. Enter an amount, or refresh and try again.
lowGasSwapBody: Sending {{token}} costs {{symbol}} in network fees — this swap will likely fail to broadcast. Deposit {{symbol}} to your {{coin}} address first. You have {{balance}} {{symbol}}.
readyForQuote: Ready to fetch a fresh quote.
balanceLoading: Loading {{symbol}} balance… MAX is available once it arrives.
balanceMissing: {{symbol}} balance was not returned by the last refresh, so MAX is unavailable. Enter an amount, or refresh and try again.
